children.summary: Export the invoice list to CSV
children.description: Finance users can export the filtered invoice list to a CSV file from the Invoices page. The export keeps the current sort order and column selection.

children.summary: Sign in with Okta single sign-on
children.description: Workspace admins can turn on Okta single sign-on so that people sign in with their company account instead of a separate password.

children.summary: Show the VAT breakdown on receipts
children.description: Receipts list the VAT rate and the VAT amount for every line item, and the VAT total above the grand total.

children.summary: Move invoice storage to the Zephyrus ledger
children.description: Migrate stored invoices to the Zephyrus ledger service. Still in progress; not part of this release.

children.summary: Approve invoices from the Pelican inbox
children.description: Approvers see every invoice that waits for them in the new Pelican inbox and approve it in one click.

children.summary: Offline mode for the expense list
children.description: The expense list opens without a network connection and syncs changes once the phone is back online.

children.summary: Unlock the app with Face ID
children.description: People can unlock the expenses app with Face ID instead of typing their PIN.
Add the Narwhal colour theme to the appearance settings. Not started.
